{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

zero_revenue_completed = zero_revenue_orders[zero_revenue_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Total revenue from COMPLETED orders (with zero revenue included)
completed_revenue = df[df['status'] == 'completed']['revenue'].sum()

# Total revenue from COMPLETED orders excluding zero-revenue ones
completed_nonzero_revenue = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] > 0)]['revenue'].sum()
